records.title: 10-Q
records.text: For the nine months ended December 31, 2021 and 2020, our revenue was $579.8 million and $495.0 million, respectively, representing year-over-year growth of 17%.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The pricing changes announced in the second quarter of fiscal 2021 have shifted our business model away from subscription-based revenue to consumption-based revenue.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Our revenue and deferred revenue have been, in part, negatively impacted by the slowdown in activity associated with the COVID-19 pandemic, but at this point, the extent of any continuing impact to our financial condition or results of operations, including cash flows, is uncertain, particularly as the COVID-19 pandemic continues to persist for an extended period of time.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Cost of revenue increased $22.8 million, or 50%, in the three months ended December 31, 2021 compared to the same period of 2020.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: During the nine months ended December 31, 2021, cash used in operating activities was $46.3 million as a result of a net loss of $175.7 million, adjusted by non-cash charges of $185.9 million and a change of $56.5 million in our operating assets and liabilities.
